meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners, ads and app prompts on Hindustan Times
meta.notes: **Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://www.hindustantimes.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. Google ad slots matched `div[data-google-query-id]`; two ad containers (1100×250 and 300×250) were visible in the viewport. `recipes/fixtures/hindustan-times/desktop-real.html` is a sanitized excerpt of an observed slot; dynamic query IDs and ad contents are omitted. No visible cookie or app banner was found; those selectors remain generic and are not verified for this site.
